seo.title: SynergyFirst Digital — Preview your New Website Before You Pay For It
seo.metaDescription: SynergyFirst Digital builds and manages professional websites for local businesses in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Europe, for one predictable monthly fee. Apply for a free preview.
seo.ogTitle: Preview your New Website Before You Pay For It
seo.ogDescription: A remote digital team building and managing local-business websites for one predictable monthly fee.

h1:
Preview your new website
before you pay for it.

sections.subheading: We build and manage professional websites for local businesses for one predictable monthly fee — no large upfront bill, no technical headaches.
sections.qualificationNote: Apply for a complimentary website preview. We review every request to make sure we can create something genuinely useful for your business.

items: Preview your website before you pay
No obligation to continue after the preview
Hosting and maintenance included with every active plan

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Tell us about your business so we can check we're a good fit.

steps.title: We build your preview website
steps.body: If you qualify, we create a private concept website for your business, at no cost.

steps.title: Review for 7 days
steps.body: Explore the preview privately. It's not public and isn't your live website yet.

steps.title: Activate or let it expire
steps.body: Like it? Activate a monthly plan and we complete and launch it. If not, it simply expires.
